accepted_inputs: canonical unsigned decimal string in range
uint64.normalization: only at declared UInt64 positions; no Number roundtrip; negative zero normalizes to zero

values: closed data-only plain objects or null-prototype objects and dense plain arrays; accessors, hidden fields, symbol keys, holes, extra array keys, derived arrays and cycles reject; caller values remain unchanged
composition: all existing checked scalar/named/optional/list/set/sum forms; exact numeric values compose through nested fields and named or inline sum payloads

equality.entity: declared Entity selector and identity value; every nonidentity field still validated
equality.value_object: declared Value Object selector and every normalized field value
equality.set: order-independent typed keys; duplicate normalized values reject
equality.optional: missing optional field and null are absent, distinct from present zero
equality.sum: retain declared type, variant tag and payload

references: explicit identity-reference and field-projection metadata retain target and exact projected type; no lookup, relationship creation, persistence binding or existence validation
compatibility: v1 model/profile/selection and outputs remain unchanged; legacy generation must reject exact models until an explicit exact realization is selected
